title: On quantitative orbit equivalence for lamplighter-like groups
summary: We focus on halo products, a class of groups introduced by Genevois and Tessera, and whose geometry mimics lamplighters. Famous examples are lampshufflers. Motivated by their work on the classifications up to quasi-isometry of these groups, we initiate a more quantitative study of their geometry.
